notes.title: Build 38 - Update Now Available
notes.content:
Hi Steam friends,

We're happy to share that we have just pushed a patch update for Fire Escape [b](Build v38).[/b]

Please see patch notes below:
[list]
[*][b]In-Game Phone Time Progression Fixed[/b] There was an issue with the in-game phone during Ep 2/3, on the Phone UI time would progress very slowly - this has been fixed, and the time on the Phone UI should correctly sync with the global game time now.
[*][b]UI Bugs[/b]- Fixes issues related to UI scale, cropping, and overlay in-game.
[/list]

We hope these issues improve the experience of Fire Escape - enjoy! :)

notes.title: 1.0.0 (36) Patch Now Available
notes.content:
Hi Steam friends,

We're happy to share that we have just pushed a patch update for Fire Escape (Build v36) .

Please see patch notes below:
[list]
[*][b]VR Pause Bug has been fixed.[/b] Previously keeping VR controllers still while playing Fire Escape would cue the pause menu to trigger - this was an issue with OpenVR sending pause commands to the game, and has now been fixed.
[*]Oculus SDK support upgraded - to fix user issues around Rift/Rift S specific bugs.
[/list]

Thanks for you patience while we fixed this issue, we hope users who were experiencing this bug are now able to enjoy Fire Escape!
